title: Forest Gate Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to nearest 24-hour A&E hospitals, urgent care, hazards, and emergency supplies in Forest Gate.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 immediately. For power outages call 105; for gas leaks call 0800 111 999.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Whipps Cross University Hospital: Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone, E11 1NR. Travel from Forest Gate station: ~30 min walk north along Woodgrange Road and Leytonstone Road, or bus 257 or 308 north.
- Newham University Hospital: Glen Road, Plaistow, E13 8SL. Travel from Forest Gate station: ~25 min walk south along Woodgrange Road, Upton Lane, and Prince Regent Lane, or bus 330 south.

2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Whipps Cross Urgent Treatment Centre: Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone, E11 1NR (co-located at the hospital entrance).
- Newham Urgent Treatment Centre: Glen Road, Plaistow, E13 8SL.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- Wanstead Flats open grassland to the immediate north poses grassfire risks during prolonged hot and dry periods; low railway bridges on Woodgrange Road and Forest Lane are vulnerable to flash flooding in heavy downpours.

4. Emergency Supplies:
Pharmacies and supermarkets along Woodgrange Road, Romford Road (A118), and Upton Lane provide essential bottled water, dry goods, and basic pharmacy supplies.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
